resources.string: No MapTiler key set. Add MAPTILER_KEY to gradle.properties and rebuild.
Notification access NOT granted — no turn guidance
Connected — start a trip in Google Maps

Turn directions are read from Google Maps\' navigation notification, so the display follows any trip you start there automatically. Google does not expose its route line to other apps, so the highlighted route comes from the destination below when you set one.
Draws a highlighted route on the map. Only needed if you want the route line — the map, your position and turn directions all work without it.

Plays a synthetic position along the route above at 50 km/h, with matching turn guidance. Exercises tile loading, heading-up rotation, the route line and the turn banner without leaving your desk. Draw a route first.
